convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorJSatl indicator which is a custom/non-standard indicator requiring separate implementation or data export from MT5

derived_values.name: Point-adjusted price distance
derived_values.used_by: order stop loss and take profit setting

other_exits: Close on opposite ColorJSatl signal reversal - color change from bullish to bearish or vice versa

custom_logic_notes: ColorJSatl is a Jurate Simple Adaptive Trend Line - a custom adaptive moving average that changes color based on trend direction. The 'Digit' suffix indicates explicit handling for 3/5 digit brokers where SL/TP values are multiplied by 10 to account for the extra decimal place. Signal reversal on ColorJSatl color change closes existing position and optionally opens opposite. The ColorJSatl indicator must be available as a custom .ex5 file for iCustom calls to work.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorJSatl custom indicator has no Python equivalent and must be reimplemented from its algorithm or its values must be exported from MT5 as CSV data. The digit adjustment logic (multiplying SL/TP by 10 for 5/3-digit brokers) must be replicated by checking symbol decimal places. Entry logic relies on color changes of the JSATL line which typically means checking buffer index 0 vs buffer index 1 for trend direction changes. Recommend: export ColorJSatl values from MT5 alongside OHLCV data for backtesting, then implement signal logic as color/buffer state change detection.
